candidates.formal_type:
∀ {n : Nat} {adj : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Int},
  Etingof.IsDynkinDiagram n adj →
    ∀ (d : Fin n → Int),
      (∀ (i : Fin n), LE.le.{0} 0 (d i)) →
        Ne.{1} d 0 →
          Eq.{1} (dotProduct.{0, 0} d (Matrix.mulVec.{0, 0, 0} (Etingof.cartanMatrix n adj) d)) 2 →
            Exists.{1} fun vertices =>
              Exists.{1} fun p =>
                Eq.{1} (Etingof.iteratedSimpleReflection n (Etingof.cartanMatrix n adj) vertices d)
                  (Etingof.simpleRoot n p)
